title: Manna Residence | Bedroom Interiors
subtitle: Sage Master Bedroom & Blue Study Bedroom
description: Two contemporary bedrooms for the Manna residence in Balurghat, a soft sage master bedroom with peacock wallpaper and a custom window seat, and a calm blue-and-white bedroom with a built-in study, gold leaf wall art and botanical Roman blinds.
body:
Designed for Dr. Sukanta Manna's residence in Balurghat, this project covers two bedrooms, each with its own palette and personality, unified by clean contemporary detailing, premium finishes and well-planned built-in storage.

The master bedroom embraces a soft sage green palette with peacock chinoiserie wallpaper, an upholstered headboard, custom wardrobes and a comfortable window seat. Layered lighting, clean architectural lines and warm metallic accents create a peaceful retreat with understated luxury.

The second bedroom shifts to a fresh dusty-blue and white scheme. A channel-tufted headboard sits beneath sculpted gold leaf wall art, botanical Roman blinds soften the windows, and a floating study desk with lit shelving is built in alongside full-height wardrobes, making the room as practical for work and study as it is restful.
features.0.title: Intelligent Space Planning
features.0.text: Every inch of the master bedroom has been carefully planned to maximize comfort and functionality. Integrated storage, seamless furniture detailing, and clear circulation create a spacious environment without compromising the minimalist design language.
features.1.title: Comfort Meets Elegance
features.1.text: The custom window seating, layered ambient lighting, and carefully selected materials create a warm and relaxing atmosphere. Soft textures and elegant detailing transform the master bedroom into a luxurious personal retreat.
features.2.title: A Calm Blue Bedroom
features.2.text: The second bedroom pairs white and dusty-blue panelling with a channel-tufted upholstered headboard and a scatter of gold leaf sculptures on the wall above. Botanical-print Roman blinds, a backlit full-length mirror and a curved, cove-lit ceiling edge keep the room light and serene.
features.3.title: Study, Storage & Personal Touches
features.3.text: A floating study desk with lit shelving is built in beside the window, flowing into full-height two-tone wardrobes. The door repeats the blue-and-white palette with fluted inlays, while a gallery of black-and-white framed prints adds a personal touch to the opposite wall.
highlights.0.title: Two Rooms, Two Palettes
highlights.0.text: Soft sage with peacock wallpaper in the master; dusty blue and white in the second bedroom.
highlights.1.title: Custom Upholstered Headboards
highlights.1.text: Bespoke headboards anchor both rooms as the visual focal point.
highlights.2.title: Built-In Study
highlights.2.text: A floating desk with lit shelving is integrated into the second bedroom's joinery.
highlights.3.title: Gold Leaf Wall Art
highlights.3.text: Sculpted gold leaves bring warmth and movement to the blue bedroom's headboard wall.
highlights.4.title: Premium Material Palette
highlights.4.text: Wallpaper, marble flooring, textured upholstery and warm metallic accents throughout.
